subject: Post-call recap: prompt/completion mix & pricing ask — NovaLabs
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ari Levin <ari@novalabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: prompt/completion mix & pricing ask — NovaLabs

Hi Ari — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap so we’re aligned and can move to a quote + eval plan. High-level notes from my side: 

- Your stated target: cost that maps to roughly $50–$90 per 1M tokens initially (you said the team wants to see unit economics before committing to Dedicated).
- Volume signal: baseline ~150M tokens/month with projected growth to ~450M over 12 months if conversion lifts go well. You noted heavy seasonality (peak x3 in Q4).
- Token mix (your estimate from the call): average prompt tokens per request ~220, average completion tokens ~620 (prompt:completion ratio ~26%:74%).
- Context needs: ~15% of requests need >8k context, ~55% need up to 32k, ~5% require occasional 128k windows for long ingestion queries, remainder are short queries (<2k).
- Latency SLO: 95th < 400ms for short completions, okay to be higher for 128k jobs.
- Quality: you prefer a single higher-quality variant for production with a cheaper fallback for low-priority batch jobs.

Action items I’m taking: 
1) Marissa will draft a targeted pricing proforma (hosted + Dedicated roughs) with three unit-price tiers keyed to monthly committed tokens and % of 32k/128k usage. Expect that by Tuesday EOD.
2) Neha will pull a short eval plan: 2-week hosted pilot with 500k sample tokens and an automated script to replay the attached usage_sample with context-length buckets.
3) Ari / Billing: please send the usage_sample CSV you mentioned (column format: timestamp, request_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, context_window_used). That will let us sanity-check the mix.

Questions I still have for you: 
- You mentioned a target blended $/1M tokens for planning — is $75 a reasonable midpoint to evaluate against? If you prefer a different anchor, tell us so we can size the proforma accordingly.
- For requests that need 128k windows, are those interactive (latency sensitive) or batch backfills? You said some are exploratory — want to confirm.

Next step: propose 30-min follow-up Wed (10/20) to review the draft proforma and pilot scope. I’ll include a short cost sensitivity table and examples showing how the prompt/completion mix shifts unit cost.

Attachments: pricing_proforma_v0 (we’ll replace with formal PDF), sample eval script outline.

Thanks — r

Rishi Malhotra
Revenue - Solutions
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Ari Levin <ari@novalabs.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Billing <billing@novalabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: prompt/completion mix & pricing ask — NovaLabs

Thanks Rishi — this captures it neatly. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The $50–$90 / 1M tokens range is what leadership expects as an upper bound for hosted pricing before we seriously consider a reserved capacity commitment. $75 is a useful anchor for the proforma.
- Volume detail: the 150M baseline is the QA/dev + internal usage. The 450M projection assumes feature rollout across three product lines (we’d want pricing that scales favorably).
- 128k windows: these are mostly batch long-form analysis jobs run nightly (not interactive). Only ~1% of the 128k requests need sub-2s latency; rest can be batch.
- We attached the sample CSV in this reply (novalabs_usage_sample.csv). Column headers: ts, req_id, prompt_toks, completion_toks, context_window.

Request for the proforma: can you include an explicit line item showing incremental cost if we convert 20% of traffic to Dedicated (reserved GPUs) versus staying hosted? Also call out any additional costs for audit logs / longer retention (we need 12 months retention for some internal teams).

Happy to take Wed 10/20 at 10am PT to review.

—Ari
Ari Levin
Head of Product
NovaLabs
ari@novalabs.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ari Levin <ari@novalabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: prompt/completion mix & pricing ask — NovaLabs

Ari — great, thanks for the clarifications and for sending the CSV. Received and skimmed. Quick follow-up and proposed deliverables before Wed: 

1) Pricing proforma (attached): hosted baseline + Dedicated conversion scenario. We’ll show blended $/1M for three tiers: 0–200M, 200–1B, 1B+ with an explicit column that models 20% shift to Dedicated. Expect proforma PDF v1 attached (redwood_pricing_proforma_v1.pdf).

2) Cost sensitivity table (inline sample): 
   - Scenario A (current mix): 150M/mo, avg prompt 220, avg completion 620 -> blended cost estimate $78 / 1M tokens (hosted baseline, no discount).
   - Scenario B (higher completions): 450M/mo, same mix -> blended estimate $63 / 1M tokens with volume bands and 10% reserved commitment.
   - Scenario C (20% Dedicated): modeled as 20% of tokens priced at Dedicated rates (lower per-token compute) -> blended $/1M drops by ~12% from hosted baseline in our model.

3) Pilot plan (Neha): 2 weeks, we’ll run the replay of novalabs_usage_sample.csv against the production variant + one cheaper fallback. Metrics to capture: token mix, avg latency by context bucket, cost delta per 1k requests, F1/ROUGE on a 100-case eval set you provide.

4) Compliance/retention: we’ll add a line item for 12-month audit log retention and estimated monthly storage cost in the proforma.

Next steps: confirm Wed 10/20 10am PT and I’ll send a calendar invite + example cost sensitivity spreadsheet beforehand. If that time doesn’t work, propose alternatives.

Thanks — talk soon.

Rishi Malhotra
Revenue - Solutions
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
